SELECT , s.site_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_article a WHERE a.bbs_master_id = m.bbs_master_id AND a.delete_yn = 'N') AS article_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_category c WHERE c.bbs_master_id = m.bbs_master_id AND c.delete_yn = 'N') AS category_count FROM tb_bbs_master m LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id
ORDER BY s.sort_order, m.bbs_code LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT , s.site_name, mn.menu_name FROM tb_bbs_master m LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id LEFT JOIN tb_menu mn ON mn.menu_id = m.menu_id WHERE m.bbs_master_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT FROM tb_bbs_master m WHERE m.site_id = #{siteId} AND m.bbs_code = #{bbsCode} AND m.use_yn = 'Y' AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_bbs_article WHERE bbs_master_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bbs_master (bbs_master_id, site_id, site_code, menu_id, bbs_code, bbs_name, bbs_type, comment_yn, file_yn, file_count_max, file_size_max, anonymous_yn, notice_top_yn, html_yn, captcha_yn, read_auth, write_auth, download_auth, grouped_board_ids, description, use_yn, created_by, created_ip, updated_by, updated_ip) VALUES (#{bbsMasterId}, #{siteId}, #{siteCode}, #{menuId}, #{bbsCode}, #{bbsName}, #{bbsType}, #{commentYn}, #{fileYn}, #{fileCountMax}, #{fileSizeMax}, #{anonymousYn}, #{noticeTopYn}, #{htmlYn}, #{captchaYn}, #{readAuth}, #{writeAuth}, #{downloadAuth}, #{groupedBoardIds}, #{description}, #{useYn}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bbs_master SET site_id = #{siteId}, site_code = #{siteCode}, bbs_code = #{bbsCode}, bbs_name = #{bbsName}, bbs_type = #{bbsType}, comment_yn = #{commentYn}, file_yn = #{fileYn}, file_count_max = #{fileCountMax}, file_size_max = #{fileSizeMax}, anonymous_yn = #{anonymousYn}, notice_top_yn = #{noticeTopYn}, html_yn = #{htmlYn}, captcha_yn = #{captchaYn}, read_auth = #{readAuth}, write_auth = #{writeAuth}, download_auth = #{downloadAuth}, use_yn = #{useYn}, menu_id = #{menuId}, grouped_board_ids = #{groupedBoardIds}, description = #{description}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE bbs_master_id = #{bbsMasterId}
UPDATE tb_bbs_master SET delete_yn = 'Y', use_yn = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE bbs_master_id = #{bbsMasterId}

UPDATE tb_file_group g JOIN tb_bbs_article a ON a.file_group_id = g.file_group_id SET g.download_auth = #{downloadAuth}, g.updated_by = #{updatedBy}, g.updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, g.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE a.bbs_master_id = #{bbsMasterId} AND a.notice_yn = 'N' AND a.delete_yn = 'N' AND g.delete_yn = 'N' AND g.download_auth <> #{downloadAuth}
